message.content: {"reasoning":"The defendant, while holding a position of trust in a private law firm, repeatedly altered check amounts and diverted portions of lawyer fees, unlawfully taking firm funds totaling 94,897.64 RMB. This conduct fits the statutory definition of misappropriation of property by a person in a position of authority over the assets, i.e., the crime of '职务侵占' (embezzlement/occupation of funds by a person in a position of duty). No other distinct offenses are indicated.", "final_answer":"[罪名]职务侵占<eoa>"}
message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: Zhang used his position in a law firm to modify checks, divert small portion of lawyer fees, and embezzled funds from the firm's account total 94,897.64 RMB. This is likely "职务侵占" (embezzlement by a person in a position of trust, i.e., misappropriation of funds). In examples, similar case: "职务侵占" used for Yang case where they misappropriated funds from organization. Also "挪用特定款物" is separate. Here it's just embezzlement of firm funds. So crime: "职务侵占". Also maybe "挪用公款"? But the firm is not a public entity; it's a private law firm. So "职务侵占" is appropriate. Also "自首" is a mitigating factor but not a crime. So answer: [罪名]职务侵占<eoa>
